story: Post-shower bathroom intimacy with fogged mirror and loosely wrapped towel.
prompt: A sensual post-shower mirror selfie in a warm steamed-up bathroom in Seongsu, Seoul. A 26-year-old Korean woman wrapped loosely in a white bath towel tucked low across her chest, bare shoulders and wet glistening collarbones exposed, damp dark hair slicked back with loose strands framing her porcelain face. One hand wiping a clean oval through the fogged glass. The phone in her hand visible in the mirror reflection is her own: a white iPhone 15 Pro with white back glass and a plain clear transparent case, held at chest height. Warm vanity bulb lighting, white ceramic tiles, soft steam haze softening highlights. Shot on iPhone 15 Pro: natural skin texture, subtle water droplets, real pores, unretouched aesthetic.
caption: fresh out of the shower... steam still on the glass. wanted you to see this first 🤍🚿
